scientific_limitations_and_integrity.integrity: Finite checker runs are consistency checks; the infinite statement is proved by the local extension argument.
limitations: Does not classify all face distributions.

scientific_limitations_and_integrity.proof_basis: Explicit K_{4,5} rotation system plus a local two-vertex rotation-system induction and Ringel's genus formula.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.scope: Existence of a specified face distribution for odd \(n\ge5\) only.

title: Two hexagonal faces in minimum-genus embeddings of \(K_{4,n}\)
